Subject: Concord MAP & final evaluation checkpoint — signoff timing and paperflow

Hi Liam / AcornAI team —

Thanks again for a productive eval week. Attached is an updated mutual action plan (Concord_MAP_v1.xlsx) and the current SOW (SOW_Concord_v3.pdf) with the implementation milestones we discussed. Summary / asks: 

- Final go/no-go: we need a firm signoff window by end of next week so we can lock GPU capacity and onboarding resources.
- Signature timing: propose DocuSign issuance on Mon 2028-09-25, countersign by Wed 2028-09-27.
- Start date: target production ramp week starting 2028-10-02 (one-week onboarding buffer after signature).
- Approvals: legal review & procurement at AcornAI (we've attached our redlines for reference).

Can you confirm the above cadence and whether the AcornAI procurement team needs additional billing or PO language? If the sign date slips more than one week we'll need to shift the start date to the following week due to reserved capacity windows.

I've looped Camila (legal/program ops) and Priyom (onboarding) to coordinate Docs/Esign and the ticketing for day-0 runbooks.

Attachments:
- Concord_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan with owners / deadlines)
- SOW_Concord_v3.pdf (final SOW draft)
- redlines_acornai_v2.docx (their redlines we received earlier)

Next steps: please reply with a brief confirmation of sign date and preferred start date; if you want to move the DocuSign window earlier we can attempt to accelerate.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: Concord MAP & final evaluation checkpoint — signoff timing and paperflow

Jordan —

Appreciate the concise plan and materials. Quick responses from our side: 

- Procurement / legal have reviewed the SOW at a high level. We do have three small billing items in their redlines (payment milestone timing, PO reference field, and data retention clause) which we've attached as an export from our tracker — see attached redlines summary.
- Signature window: Monday the 25th is tight for our CFO to sign. We can commit to a DocuSign envelope on Tue 2028-09-26 and countersign by Fri 2028-09-29. Could you confirm whether that still meets your capacity reservation requirements?
- Start date: given the above, a start of 2028-10-09 is cleaner for us (two-week buffer from signature to ramp). If Redwood needs Oct 2, we'd need a hard assurance on the Oct 2 availability and a partial hold on seats.

Also, please send an invoice template or pro-forma if you need a PO before signature.

Thanks Jordan — looping in a quick internal status and recommendation.

1) Legal / procurement notes:
- We've reviewed AcornAI's redlines (redlines_acornai_v2.docx). The three billing items Liam flagged are standard. Our recommended edit is to accept the PO reference field and propose a 30-day invoice milestone schedule rather than up-front 50% to keep their procurement happy.
- Data retention clause: we've proposed explicit customer-data-inference-only language; tracked changes attached.

2) Signature cadence recommendation:
- If AcornAI can issue DocuSign on Tue 2028-09-26 and countersign by Fri 2028-09-29, we can accommodate that without losing reserved capacity provided we receive a signed PO or purchase reference by Thu 2028-09-28.
- If we don't have PO or payment confirmation by Thu (28th), our recommended start date becomes 2028-10-16 to protect allocation for committed customers.

3) Operational readiness:
- Priyom will prepare onboarding runbooks and a day-0 checklist. Priyom, target a dry-run with AcornAI on Wed 2028-10-03 if the signature lands in the 26-29 window.

Camila Reyes
Director, Legal & Program Ops | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: tracked_SOW_concord_changes.pdf

Team,

I reviewed Camila's recommendations and the redlines from AcornAI. Approval notes: 

- Approve the 30-day invoice milestone and accept the three billing edits as proposed in tracked_SOW_concord_changes.pdf.
- Authorize DocuSign to be issued on Tue 2028-09-26. Legal and contracts can finalize the envelope.
- We will hold the reserved capacity for a single week buffer; therefore we can commit to start date 2028-10-09 if signature completes on or before 2028-09-29 and a PO reference is provided by 2028-09-28.
- SLA exception: approve a one-time 99.5% SLO for the first 30 days as a goodwill concession. Priyom, reflect in onboarding notes and billing.

Jordan — please issue the DocuSign envelope Tue morning and confirm the HubSpot deal stage update (move to "Signed - Awaiting Kickoff").
